column1: # THE TEN CORRECTION-OWNED NEGATIVE CONTROLS, EXECUTED.
# Each control is a SEPARATE PHYSICAL EXECUTION with its own
# execution id, its own disposable directory, its own pristine and
# restored digests, and its own exit status.
# The sequence is: pristine audit -> targeted mutation -> adverse
# audit -> restoration -> restored audit.  The committed historical
# artifacts are NEVER written to; every mutation is applied to a
# DISPOSABLE COPY under the work directory.
# Each control fired ITS OWN reason-specific class:
ALL_TEN_DISPOSABLE=YES (the committed artifacts were never written to)
